# Biz4Group

> > Biz4Group is a top AI software development company based in Orlando, FL, specializing in AI chatbots, IoT solutions, enterprise software, and custom application development.

Founded by industry leaders including Brian W. Mead, Sanjeev Verma, and Apporva Verma, Biz4Group delivers cutting-edge solutions across industries including education, healthcare, eCommerce, and real estate. The company emphasizes Agile methodology, API-first architecture, and emerging technologies like multi-agent AI systems.
